description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample that generates an invoice PDF template with methods for retrieving the template type, body, header, and footer. It references external services and translation functions to build the invoice layout.

classes.name: smpl_Invoice_Group_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate invoice PDF templates, including body, header, and footer content.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Invoices'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the invoice body, including invoice details and line items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string for the header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the invoice footer, including page number and date.
